## Definition of Done

- [ ] PR title is a valid Conventional Commit in English (`type(scope): description`)
- [ ] Code, comments and identifiers are in English
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test`)
- [ ] Documentation updated in this PR (`docs/`, `.dev/` checklist) — or "N/A" explained below
- [ ] New/changed table: RLS enabled + access tests (allowed **and** denied) — or N/A
- [ ] Permission/role change: `docs/permissions.md` updated — or N/A
- [ ] Database change: new migration only (no edit of existing ones) — or N/A
- [ ] No secret, no `.env*` file, no `service_role` key exposed to the client
- [ ] PR is small (~400 lines) and stays inside the checklist scope
- [ ] This PR was (partly) generated by an LLM and has been reviewed line by line by a human
